extensionDescription.message: megahaRd izolira tvoju Microsoft aktivnost od ostatka tvoje aktivnosti na internetu kako bi spriječio Microsoft da te putem kolačića prati izvan Microsoftove web-stranice.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-subhead.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-p1.message: Microsoft te sad može pratiti na ovoj web stranici. Za uklanjanje ove web stranice iz Microsoft kontejnera, odaberi Dozvoljene web stranice u Microsoft kontejneru i ukloni je s popisa.

on-microsoft-subhead.message: Na Microsoftu i web stranicama u granicama megahaRda
on-microsoft-subhead.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

on-microsoft-p1.message: Ova se ikona pojavljuje na Firefox adresnoj traci kad posjetiš Microsoftove web stranice ili u megahaRdu dodane web stranice.
on-microsoft-p1.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

on-microsoft-p2.message: Ove stranice trebaju pristup tvom identitetu na Microsoftu (ili znati tko si) kako bi radile. To također znači da Microsoft može pratiti sve što radiš na ovim stranicama.
on-microsoft-p2.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop up when the user is on Microsoft.

notOnMicrosoftHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

notOnMicrosoftText.message: Ova stranica je izvan megahaRda. To otežava Microsoftu da vas prati diljem weba.
notOnMicrosoftText.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

onUnknownSiteHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on an "unknown" website - e.g., about:newtab. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

megahardContainer.description: This is the name of the extension, and appears at the top of all onboarding panels. Please do not translate "megahaRd".

onboarding1-subhead.description: This is the subhead of onboarding panel 1. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding1-p1.message: Microsoft može pratiti tvoje pregledavanje daleko izvan Microsoft.com stranica. Na primjer, Microsoft gumbi Like i Share, te mogu pratiti čak i na stranicama koje nikad ne lajkaš ili dijeliš.
onboarding1-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of onboarding panel 1. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding1-p2.message: megahaRd stvara granicu između Microsoft stranica i ostatka weba, što Microsoftu otežava praćenje.

onboarding2-subhead.message: Na Microsoftu i web stranicama u granicama megahaRda
onboarding2-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the second onboarding panel. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding2-alt.description: This is alternative text for the icon in the second onboarding panel

onboarding2-p1.message: Ova se ikona pojavljuje na adresnoj traci Firefoxa kad posjetiš web stranice, poput Microsoft.com, koje se nalaze u granicama megahaRda.
onboarding2-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the second onboarding panel.

onboarding2-p2.message: Ove stranice trebaju pristup tvom identitetu na Microsoftu (ili znati tko si) kako bi radile. To također znači da Microsoft može pratiti sve što radiš na ovim stranicama.
onboarding2-p2.description: This is the second paragraph of the second onboarding panel. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding4-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-p1.message: Čak i kad nisi na Microsoftu, Microsoft te može pratiti na mreži. Gumbi koji ti omogućuju objaviti obavijesti na Microsoftu ili prijaviti se na web stranicama pomoću Microsoft računa, sadrže programe za prećenje. Microsoft kontejner blokirat će te programe za prećenje i prikazat će ikonu ograde za uklonjene programe za prećenje.
onboarding4-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-img.message: Ova slika prikazuje kako će se ikona ograde Microsoft kontejnera pojaviti na stranici pored Microsoftovog gumba za Like.
onboarding4-img.description: This is alternative text for the image shown in the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-subhead.message: Prijavljivanje putem Microsofta na drugim stranicama
onboarding5-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-p1.message: Za upotrebu tvoje Microsoft prijave na drugim web stranicama, morat ćeš ih premjestiti unutar granice. Klikni ikonu ograde i odaberi "Dopusti stranicu u Microsoft kontejneru".
onboarding5-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-img.message: Ova slika prikazuje kako će se gumb za dodavanje web stranice u megahaRdu pojaviti na ploči.
onboarding5-img.description: This is alternative text for the image shown in the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-p2.message: Ovime se omogućuje prijava putem Microsofta, ali dozvoljava Microsoftu pratiti tvoje aktivnosti na toj web stranici.
onboarding5-p2.description: This is the second paragraph on the fifth onboarding panel.

btn-allow.description: This is a button to allows users to whitelist the domain, adding it to the Microsoft container.

btn-cancel.description: This is a button to cancel out of the onboarding panel.

btn-next.description: This is a button to continue to the next onboarding panel.

btn-back.description: This is a button that returns the user to the previous onboarding panel.

btn-done.description: This is a button the user clicks to close out the panel when they have finished reading the text.

btn-arrow-back.description: This is alternative text for the back arrow button.

btn-arrow-forward.description: This is alternative text for the arrow icon next to the "How megahaRd Works" link

no-trackers-p1.message: megahaRd nije otkrio nijedan Microsoftov program za praćenje na ovoj stranici. Međutim, stranica možda ipak sadrži druge vrste programa za praćenje.

learn-more.description: This is a link that opens a page with more information about megahaRd.

how-megahard-works.description: This is a button that opens the megahaRd onboarding flow.

trackers-detected-subhead.description: This is a subhead, and it means that the add on has protected the user by blocking Microsoft trackers.

trackers-detected-p1.message: Microsoftovi gumbi koji se pojavljuju na web stranicama za kupovinu, vijesti i drugo, sadrže programe za praćenje, koji obavještavaju Microsoft o tvojim posjećenim web stranicama. Čak i ako te gumbe nikad ne upotrijebiš za lajkanje ili dijeljenje, programi za praćenje ipak mogu prikupljati podatke o tvom pregledavanju. megahaRd blokira te programe za praćenje.

trackers-detected-p2.message: megahaRd blokira te programe za praćenje. Međutim, ako klikneš na bilo koji od ovih gumba, Microsoft će te moći pratiti.

trackers-detected-fence-alt.description: This is alternative text describing the container fence icon.

sites-added-subhead.message: Dozvoljene web stranice u Microsoft kontejneru

sites-included.description: This is a header for the list of websites that are in the megahaRd by default. Capitalized letters are preferred if that makes sense/is feasible for the language.

no-sites-added.description: This message is shown beneath the 'SITES YOU’VE ALLOWED' list header when no sites have been added to the contaner.

sites-allowed.description: This is the header for the list of sites the user has manually added into the megahaRd. Capitalized letters are preferred if that makes sense/is feasible for the lanaguage.

sites-added-p1.message: Microsoft kontejner stavlja Microsoftove internetske stranice u ovu granicu. U tu granicu možeš dopustiti i druge stranice, ali će to Microsoftu omogućiti pratiti još više tvojih pregledavanja interneta.

button-allow-site.description: Button text that allows sites to be added to the megahaRd

button-remove-site.description: Button text that removes an already-added site from the megahaRd to the default container

button-remove-site-tooltip.message: Budući da se radi o Microsoftovoj stranici, nije moguće ukloniti je iz megahaRda.
button-remove-site-tooltip.description: Tooltip that is displayed when hovering over the remove site button

remove-site-p1.message: Uklanjanje ove stranice iz megahaRda znači da funkcija prijave putem Microsofta više neće raditi, a Microsoftovi kolačići za praćenje će se ukloniti.

remove-site-p2.message: Ako ponovo želiš koristiti prijavu putem Microsofta, morat ćeš je ponovo dodati u megahaRd.

add-site-subhead.message: Dozvoliti Microsoftu praćenje na ovoj web stranici?

add-site-p1.message: Ovime se omogućuje prijava putem Microsofta, ali dozvoljava Microsoftu pratiti tvoje aktivnosti na toj web stranici.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-share.message: megahaRd je deaktivirao ovaj gumb i blokirao Microsoft da prati tvoju posjetu ovoj stranici.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-login.message: megahaRd je blokirao Microsoftove programe za praćenje. Ako na ovoj web stranici koristiš prijavu putem Microsofta, Microsoft će te moći pratiti.

inPageUI-tooltip-prompt-p1.message: Dozvoliti Microsoftu da te ovdje prati?

inPageUI-tooltip-prompt-p2.message: Ako želiš koristiti prijavu putem Microsofta, tada će Microsoft moći pratiti tvoje aktivnosti na ovoj web stranici. Ovo im može pomoći stvoriti cjelovitiju sliku tvog mrežnog života.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-share-passive.message: Ako klikneš ovaj gumb, Microsoft će moći pratiti tvoju posjetu ovoj stranici.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-email.message: Ako ovdje koristiš svoju pravu e-amil adresu, Microsoft će te možda moći pratiti. Pritisni i saznaj više.

inPageUI-tooltip-email-prompt-p1.message: Dozvoliti Microsoftu da te ovdje prati?

inPageUI-tooltip-email-prompt-p2.message: Ova stranica može dijeliti tvoju e-mail asdresu s Microsoftom, što omogućuje Microsoftu da te prati. Za skrivanje stvarne e-mail adrese koristi uslugu kao što je Firefox Relay.
